headline: Licensed across all seven jurisdictions
description: Every AfriGold Hub operating site holds current mining licences, environmental certificates, and revenue authority registrations. All documentation is available to investors during due diligence.

items.title: Mining Licence (ML)
items.issuer: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM)
items.description: Active Mining Licence issued under Uganda's Mining Act 2003 and associated regulations, covering our primary alluvial and BIF-hosted extraction zones in Busia District, Eastern Region. Grants the right to extract, process, and sell gold bullion from the licensed acreage.
items.licence_body: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM), Uganda

items.title: Environmental Impact Assessment Certificate
items.description: NEMA EIA certificate covering the gravity concentration processing facility and extraction zones at our Busia primary site. Confirms full compliance with Uganda's National Environment Act 2019 and the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations. Annual inspection passed without conditions for five consecutive years.
items.licence_body: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM), Uganda

items.title: Water Abstraction Permit
items.issuer: Directorate of Water Resources Management (DWRM), Uganda
items.description: Permit to abstract and recycle water for gravity concentration processing operations at the Busia site. Full water management plan in place, achieving 92% water recycling across our sluice and spiral concentrator system. Zero untreated process water enters natural waterways.
items.licence_body: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM), Uganda
items.env_body: Directorate of Water Resources Management (DWRM), Uganda

items.title: Precious Metals Dealer Registration
items.description: URA registration as a licensed artisanal gold producer and precious metals dealer. All gold sales are receipted under URA documentation with mineral royalty declarations filed per transaction. Royalty rate: 3% of gross value for artisanal gold under the Uganda Mining and Minerals Act.
items.licence_body: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM), Uganda

items.title: Assay Laboratory Accreditation
items.description: UNBS accreditation for our on-site and third-party fire assay processes, confirming conformance to UNBS gold purity testing standards. Every bar produced at the Busia facility receives an independent assay certificate before sale, consistently achieving 99.5–99.7% purity.
items.licence_body: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM), Uganda

items.title: Community Development Agreement
items.issuer: Busia District Local Government, in partnership with DGSM
items.description: Formally registered CDA filed under Section 134 of the Uganda Mining and Minerals Act. Commits 3% of monthly net profits to local development projects including borehole water access, school infrastructure, and vocational training for youth in Busia District. Reviewed and renewed biannually.
items.licence_body: Directorate of Geological Survey and Mines (DGSM), Uganda

items.title: Mining Licence (ML)
items.issuer: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya
items.description: Active Mining Licence issued under Kenya's Mining Act 2016, covering alluvial and BIF-hosted gold extraction zones in Migori County. Includes the right to extract, process, and sell gold bullion from the licensed concession. Administered through the Mining Cadastre Portal.
items.licence_body: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya

items.title: Environmental Impact Assessment Certificate
items.description: NEMA EIA certificate for our Migori County gravity concentration facility under the Environmental Management and Coordination Act (EMCA) 1999 and EIA Regulations 2003. Confirms zero chemical use. Annual site inspection passed without conditions. Certificate valid to 2026.
items.licence_body: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya

items.title: Water Abstraction Permit
items.description: WRA permit to abstract and recycle water for gravity concentration processing at the Migori County site, issued under the Water Act 2016. Full water management plan approved. Closed-loop recycling system achieves 91% water recovery at the Kenya site.
items.licence_body: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya

items.title: Precious Metals Dealer Registration
items.description: KRA registration as a licensed precious metals dealer under the Customs and Excise Act, with Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) foreign exchange approval for international settlement. All gold sales receipted and declared. Mineral royalty filed per consignment at the prevailing rate under the Mining Act 2016.
items.licence_body: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya

items.title: Assay Laboratory Accreditation
items.description: KEBS accreditation to KS ISO 11426 for fire assay and gold purity testing at our Kenya site. Every bar produced receives an independent purity certificate before sale. Minimum purity standard: 99.5%. Accreditation covers both on-site sample preparation and third-party confirmatory assay.
items.licence_body: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya

items.title: NITA Skills Training Certification
items.description: NITA certification for vocational skills training programme covering all mine operators and processing technicians at the Kenya site. Ongoing training curriculum developed in partnership with NITA covering ore handling, gravity concentration operation, smelting safety, and first aid.
items.licence_body: Mines and Geology Department, Ministry of Petroleum and Mining, Kenya

items.title: Mining Licence
items.issuer: Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency (TMAA), Ministry of Minerals
items.description: Active Primary Mining Licence (PML) issued under Tanzania's Mining Act 2010 (as amended 2017), covering alluvial gold extraction zones in the Geita District. All gold production is audited and receipted by TMAA under TANSORT protocols. Royalty rate: 3% of gross value.
items.licence_body: Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency (TMAA), Ministry of Minerals

items.title: Environmental Certificate
items.description: NEMC environmental certificate under the Environmental Management Act 2004, covering our Geita District operations. Confirms zero chemical use and compliance with Tanzania's Minamata Convention obligations. Annual monitoring report submitted and accepted without conditions.
items.licence_body: Tanzania Minerals Audit Agency (TMAA), Ministry of Minerals

items.title: Artisanal Mining Licence
items.issuer: Mines and Mineral Resources Department (MMRD), Sierra Leone
items.description: Artisanal mining licence issued under the Mines and Minerals Act 2009 (Sierra Leone), covering alluvial and eluvial gold extraction zones in Kono District, Eastern Province. Includes right to process gold using approved chemical-free methods and sell to licensed buyers.
items.licence_body: Mines and Mineral Resources Department (MMRD), Sierra Leone

items.title: Environmental Permit
items.description: EPA environmental permit under the Environment Protection Agency Act 2008, covering our Kono District gravity concentration operation. Confirms compliance with Sierra Leone's national environmental standards and the Minamata Convention mercury phase-out commitments.
items.licence_body: Mines and Mineral Resources Department (MMRD), Sierra Leone

items.title: Mining Permit
items.issuer: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE), South Africa
items.description: Artisanal and small-scale mining permit issued under South Africa's Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act 2002 (MPRDA), covering surface alluvial and eluvial concessions in the West Rand, Gauteng. Includes right to extract, process, and sell gold under SARS-registered dealer status.
items.licence_body: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE), South Africa
items.env_body: Department of Environment, Forestry and Fisheries (DEFF) / DWS, South Africa

items.title: Water Use Licence
items.issuer: Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), South Africa
items.description: Water Use Licence under the National Water Act 36 of 1998, authorising water abstraction and process water recycling at our West Rand site. Closed-loop system achieves 93% water recovery. Annual DWS compliance report submitted on schedule.
items.licence_body: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE), South Africa
items.env_body: Department of Water and Sanitation (DWS), South Africa

items.title: Assay Accreditation
items.description: SANAS accreditation for fire assay and gold purity testing at our South Africa site, conforming to SANS/ISO 11426 and SANAS technical criteria. All consignments receive third-party SANAS-accredited assay certificates before sale to SARS-registered buyers.
items.licence_body: Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DMRE), South Africa
items.env_body: Department of Environment, Forestry and Fisheries (DEFF), South Africa

items.title: Mining Licence
items.issuer: Geological Survey of Eswatini, Ministry of Natural Resources and Energy
items.description: Mining licence issued under Eswatini's Mines and Quarries Act 1958 (as amended), covering alluvial gold extraction zones in the Hhohho Region. Issued in consultation with the Minerals Committee under the Ngwenyama. Active geological remapping underway in partnership with the South African Council for Geoscience since 2023.
items.licence_body: Geological Survey of Eswatini, Ministry of Natural Resources and Energy

items.title: Environmental Authorisation
items.description: EEA environmental authorisation under the Environment Management Act 2002 of Eswatini, covering our Hhohho Region gravity concentration operation. Confirms zero chemical use and compliance with national environmental standards. Positions our operation in line with Eswatini's emerging mineral sector sustainability framework.
items.licence_body: Geological Survey of Eswatini, Ministry of Natural Resources and Energy

items.title: Mining Licence
items.issuer: Mines Department, Ministry of Natural Resources and Climate Change, Malawi
items.description: Active mining licence issued under Malawi's Mines and Minerals Act 2019, covering alluvial and eluvial gold extraction zones in Mchinji District, Central Region. Includes right to process gold using chemical-free gravity methods and sell to licensed buyers under MRA oversight.
items.licence_body: Mines Department, Ministry of Natural Resources and Climate Change, Malawi

items.title: Environmental Certificate
items.description: EAD environmental certificate under the Environment Management Act 2017 of Malawi, covering our Mchinji District gravity concentration operation. Confirms compliance with Malawi's national environmental standards and chemical-free processing obligations under the Minamata Convention, to which Malawi is a signatory.
items.licence_body: Mines Department, Ministry of Natural Resources and Climate Change, Malawi

cda.title: Community Development Agreement (CDA)
cda.description: Formally registered with the Regional Community Government under Section 134 of the Mining Act. Commits 3% of monthly net profits to community infrastructure, education, and water access projects in our operational region.
